chapter.title: Estimation, Hypothesis Tests and Confidence Procedures

sections.title: Misspecification, nonidentification and failures of routine inference

missing_pieces.duty: US-0 (nonidentification part of the planned 'Misspecification, nonidentification and failures of routine inference' extent): the route has misspecification (w02b-p15-057 misspecified-family section; Huber M-estimation under arbitrary F) and failures of routine inference (owned nonnormal, nonuniform and uniform-regime theorems; robust sampling boundary), all with proofs. Nonidentification appears only in passing: a three-sentence closing remark in the proof of thm:p15-huber-asymmetric-bias, and the intersecting-class case of thm:p15-robust-overlap. Nothing on the route defines nonidentification as a failure mode and proves what it does to routine estimation, testing and confidence. The owned chapter's toc tag claims 169.11, yet it has no such section. Owed, with proofs and a worked example, in the owned body and annex: observationally equivalent parameter values cannot be separated by any consistent estimator; a test of one against another has power at most its size there; and a confidence procedure with the stated coverage must cover the whole equivalence class.
